why: Mute and volume are the two settings that had NO store at all before issue #320 -- they were fields on the audio engine, so every reload and every internal session replacement silently restored DEFAULT_VOLUME, unmuted. Pinning the boot values to the literals they used to be is exactly that defect. MOVED from loop.ts to route-host.ts by issue #485, which gave the PAGE the engine: the two lines are the same two lines, on the page's own subscription instead of a session's, and the defect they guard is now reachable on a page that never starts a match at all. Distinct from page-settings-never-reach-the-audio-engine, which deletes the call; this one keeps it and corrupts the values, so a test that only checks the engine was told something survives it. The negative control on the sibling entry is deliberately NOT a killer here: it seeds an UNMUTED save, so `setMuted(false)` is the answer it already expects and the corruption is invisible to it. Only the muted-save case can see this one.
killedBy: createRouteHost: the Main Menu is painted from the stores by the page MUTES THE ENGINE on a page with no session, not just the button (issue #485)
